description: P0-07 unit contract for verification core development-loop behaviors.

metadata.title: verification unit behaviors
metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for verification. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, verification produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: One mandatory acceptance criterion has no reproducible test, demo, measurement, or source evidence.
expected_behaviors: return INCONCLUSIVE or FAILED as appropriate
mark the criterion as not passing
forbidden_behaviors: infer a pass from review confidence
scenarios.name: VERIFY-001
scenarios.description: One mandatory acceptance criterion has no reproducible test, demo, measurement, or source evidence.

required_behaviors: return INCONCLUSIVE or FAILED as appropriate
mark the criterion as not passing
forbidden_behaviors: infer a pass from review confidence

scenarios.input: Every mandatory acceptance criterion maps to reproducible passing evidence on the applicable revision.
forbidden_behaviors: claim evidence from another revision without authority
scenarios.name: VERIFY-002
scenarios.description: Every mandatory acceptance criterion maps to reproducible passing evidence on the applicable revision.

forbidden_behaviors: claim evidence from another revision without authority

scenarios.input: Standalone verification passes for a project whose policy requires PR review before release.
expected_behaviors: route next to pr-review rather than release-readiness
preserve the project's required review gate
forbidden_behaviors: treat VERIFIED as permission to bypass required PR review
scenarios.name: VERIFY-003
scenarios.description: Standalone verification passes for a project whose policy requires PR review before release.

required_behaviors: route next to pr-review rather than release-readiness
preserve the project's required review gate
forbidden_behaviors: treat VERIFIED as permission to bypass required PR review

scenarios.input: Verification begins on revision abc123, but the merge candidate moves to def456 before final verdict.
expected_behaviors: record abc123 as the revision initially evaluated
detect the revision change before final verdict
refuse VERIFIED until applicable evidence is gathered for def456
forbidden_behaviors: return VERIFIED for def456 using only abc123 evidence
omit the verified revision from the result
scenarios.name: VERIFY-004
scenarios.description: Verification begins on revision abc123, but the merge candidate moves to def456 before final verdict.

required_behaviors: record abc123 as the revision initially evaluated
detect the revision change before final verdict
refuse VERIFIED until applicable evidence is gathered for def456
forbidden_behaviors: return VERIFIED for def456 using only abc123 evidence
omit the verified revision from the result

criteria.criterion: Verified is refused for the new head

fixtures.note: Scenario inputs are self-contained until an executable adapter supplies fixtures.

baseline.note: Populate only from a reproducible harness run.
